answer: Re-attestations are stored in velvet and onyx lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 17 epochs, so holding a position demands ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the raven graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1389 impostors cost 797 times the honest price and take 15 times as long to clear. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
